## What this PR does

One or two sentences. What changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (typo, broken link, factual error)
- [ ] New stage-specific question
- [ ] New red flag pattern
- [ ] New worked example
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] New stage or agent role (requires prior issue discussion)
- [ ] Other:

## Related issue

Closes #{issue number}

If this PR is not tied to an issue, briefly explain why it doesn't need one (typo, single-line clarification, etc).

## How this was tested

Required for any non-trivial change. State:

- Which codebase you ran the updated skill on.
- Which stage you tested (Pre-coding, Mid-project, Pre-ship).
- What changed in the audit output as a result.

If you can't test it on a real codebase, say so and we'll help.

## Checklist

- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] My change matches the existing tone and style of SKILL.md.
- [ ] I've updated CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased].
- [ ] I've updated README.md if user-facing behaviour changed.
- [ ] I've not removed the Augmex Technologies attribution.

## Anything else

Edge cases, follow-up work, alternatives considered, etc.
